scientific_integrity: The general optimum is derived analytically from exact network resistance identities, strict convexity, a scalar minimization and Cauchy--Schwarz. Exact-rational and floating-point tests corroborate but do not establish the universal theorem. The author-hosted 2008 paper is the earliest inspected primary source with a verified precise public day; a July 2006 conference version is acknowledged but its first public day was not verified. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only clique petals joined at a single hub, with two internally uniform per-block edge-cost classes.
No cross-petal edges, and no general theorem for individually priced edges within one petal.
The full specialized 2025 windmill-index article could not be read, leaving a historical originality risk.
Finite numeric checks are not proof and independent validation remains unperformed.
title: Universal internal-edge price threshold for resistance-optimal clique bouquets
